summary: The proposed patch introduces a non-minimal change and may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch creates an empty `__init__.py` file in directories, which is not a minimal change and may have unintended side effects on other parts of the codebase.
The approach of creating an empty `__init__.py` file is fragile and may not handle all edge cases, such as directories that should not be treated as packages.
